zh: 多个分叉的对话行点不开：皮肤之前直接搬动渲染器列表的座位，React 重绘后行会失效。改为走宿主自己的工作区会话排序（拖动行用的同一个 setSessionOrder 写），行由渲染器自己摆，点击始终有效；嵌套顺序也随重启保留（排序模式随写入手动）
en: Forked session rows could go unclickable: the skin moved the renderer's list seats itself, and React's keyed re-render could leave dead rows. The lineage now writes the workspace view's own session-order store - the same write a row drag makes - so the renderer keeps owning its rows and clicks always work; the nesting also survives reloads (the write puts the order mode on manual)
